args.title: Accept application/octet-stream for .csv uploads
args.body:
File: src/routes/uploads.ts

Accept application/octet-stream as a valid content type for file uploads when the file name ends with .csv, allowing uploads from curl and generic upload clients that omit the CSV MIME type.
